title: gigaCCS Consortium Days 2026: Celebrating how far CCS has come, while recognising how far it has to go
summary: Around 130 members met in Trondheim for the 2026 gigaCCS Consortium Days. According to the centre, public trust emerged as the key test of how far CCS can go.
why_it_matters: Public acceptance shapes siting of pipelines, terminals and storage, a constraint Nordic network-design models increasingly need to reflect.
